verdicts.reason: A and B are pixel-identical and broken in the same ways. The play-arrow icon is blown up into a huge pixelated white shape that dominates the right third. The empty frame of lines sits alone in the middle with no text inside it, so the frame is cut off from its content. Copy is scattered in three columns and the orange tint covers only the middle strip, so the background reads as a dark, broken mess rather than the original's warm, framed poster.
